blocks.text: universe.saves@1.0.0 requires core.save and core.universe-save-format. Each controller receives a current session/world identity and a restore command. Container decoding is inert. The host retains exact-package approval, engine validation and candidate activation. Recheck the supplied guard immediately before publication. Abort or dispose cancels pending operations; failed or stale operations retain the active world. Only one operation per controller is allowed. Saves retain the .spaceuniverse filename and Save universe / Load universe naming.
